thesis: TGTX is a profitable commercial biotech (Q3 revenue 259.9M, +60.7% YoY, raised guidance, positive FCF) in a clean uptrend at all-time highs after the 11/24 Briumvi sBLA acceptance, and healthcare is a leading sector in this risk-off tape. The entry is poor, though. Pre-market 69.34 sits above the 66.5-69.0 zone, and reward/risk at that price is only about 1.2 to the 79.5 measured-move target with the 61.0 stop (about 1.6 from 68). With a stretched RSI of 69, the price above the mean analyst target, beta 1.8 and a risk-off regime (VIX 99th percentile), this stays a watchlist Hold until a pullback into the lower half of the zone makes the setup work.
invalidation: A daily close below 64.06 (low of the 11/24 breakout bar) signals a failed breakout, and a close below 61.5 (10-day swing low) breaks the uptrend.
key_risks: Post-news-spike fade: price is 11.9% above SMA20 with RSI 69.3 and pre-market 69.34 below the 70.13 close
Risk-off regime with QQQ below its 50/200-day averages and VIX 31.19; beta 1.8 magnifies market drawdowns
Rich valuation (trailing P/E 104.67, P/S 11.81) with price above the 69.43 mean analyst target and sequential revenue growth slowing
Short interest 27.37% of float and ATR 4.72% of price mean volatility in both directions
Ocrevus-copy competitive risk and the Halper Sadeh shareholder-rights investigation headline
